This '''Cooking range''', referred to as the '''Cook-o-matic 100''' by the [[Cook (Lumbridge)|Lumbridge Cook]] (more commonly referred to as the '''Lumbridge Castle Range''' or simply the '''Cook's range''') is a special [[cooking range|range]], located in the kitchen, on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} of the [[Lumbridge Castle]]. 

It is notable as it improves the chances of cooking certain foods, especially [[mushroom pie|mushroom]] and [[botanical pie]]s. This makes it particularly helpful for players without access to other special cooking ranges, or a [[cooking cape]].

But only those who have completed the [[Cook's Assistant]] quest may use it. If one tries before then, the cook will stop them.

==Trivia==
* The range is referred to by the Cook as the "Cook-o-matic 100", but in ''[[rsw:RuneScape|RuneScape]]'' it's referred to as the "Cook-o-matic 25" by the cook-o-matic manual. It is unknown why this is inconsistent.
